scenes.title: 3 things to know before buying Brightin Star
scenes.say: Thinking about a Brightin Star lens? Three things to know first.

scenes.title: "90-day returns" has big exceptions
scenes.say: One. The ninety day return only covers defects and shipping mistakes. No change of mind returns, and orders placed with discount codes can't be returned at all.

scenes.title: Pick the right mount
scenes.say: Two. Order the wrong mount and you pay a forty percent restocking fee plus shipping both ways. Check APS C versus full frame too.

scenes.title: Slow unless you pay
scenes.say: Three. Standard shipping takes eighteen to twenty five business days. Express takes six to nine, free only over three hundred fifty nine dollars.

scenes.title: Cheap fast lenses, strict policies
scenes.say: The good part: prices are low and there's a two year warranty. Our full review is on WiseChoice K R dot com.
